actions.run_search: seq:text:curl -s "https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search_by_date?tags=front_page&hitsPerPage=8" -o /tmp/hn.json && python3 -c 'import json;d=json.load(open("/tmp/hn.json"));[print(h["points"],"pts ::",h["title"]) for h in d["hits"]]' && echo ==NEWS1-DO""NE==|Return
actions.run_fetch: seq:text:python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("/tmp/hn.json"))["hits"][0]["objectID"])' > /tmp/topid && curl -s "https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/items/$(cat /tmp/topid)" -o /tmp/art.json && python3 -c 'import json,re;d=json.load(open("/tmp/art.json"));w=open("/tmp/digest.txt","w");lines=["NEWS DIGEST — top story today","","HEADLINE: "+d["title"],"SOURCE: "+(d.get("url") or "news.ycombinator.com"),"","What readers say:"]+["- "+re.sub("<[^>]+>"," ",c["text"])[:160].replace(chr(10)," ") for c in (d.get("children") or [])[:4]];w.write(chr(10).join(lines));w.close();print(chr(10).join(lines))' && echo ==NEWS2-DO""NE==|Return
